programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Overland Riders
programme.desc: Cowboy Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is riding in a stagecoach with young Jean (Patti McCarty), on his way to a business deal with her father. The coach is attacked by bandits, but luckily Fuzzy's buddy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) is in the vicinity, and he comes to the rescue, fending off the outlaws. Billy helps Jean get back home, only to learn that the bandits he's just thwarted have killed her father and pinned the crime on Fuzzy. Billy then must go after the real murderers.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: The Hawk of Powder River
programme.desc: Vivian Chambers (Jennifer Holt) has a secret identity. She moonlights as "the Hawk," a villain who leads a gang of criminals. Vivian's uncle owns a ranch, and she wants to commandeer it. After her uncle catches a glimpse of the Hawk's secret lair, Vivian kills him and decides to go after his daughter, Carole (June Carlson), as well. Now it's up to Deputy Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to save Carole and defeat Vivian and her bandit minions.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Oklahoma Annie
programme.desc: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault -- and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland).

The superintendent of his building (Luis Guzmán) is stabbed by hoodlums hired by his own rebellious daughter (Melonie Diaz). To top it off, a sexually aggressive chiropractor (Elizabeth Hurley) may just be Ray's undoing.

programme.title: The Stranger
programme.desc: Immediately following World War II, ex-Nazi Franz Kindler is living under a false identity as a teacher in a small Connecticut town, and has even married the headmaster's daughter as part of his cover. But when one of Kindler's old German associates arrives unexpectedly in town, bringing in his wake a sly federal investigator, Kindler resorts to desperate measures to preserve his secret.

programme.title: Flaming Bullets
programme.desc: A criminal syndicate has been illegally freeing convicts, only to murder them after authorities offer reward money for the fugitives' scalps. Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) are charged with catching the thugs, and they hit upon a plan: Dave will get himself put in jail, the thugs break him free and Tex and Panhandle will arrest them. But, when the criminals realize the Rangers are closing in, things turn deadly.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

programme.title: Stars Over Texas
programme.desc: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene.

programme.title: Return of the Lash
programme.desc: Cheyenne Davis (Lash La Rue) comes to the rescue of a group of ranchers who are losing their homes to a gang of malicious outlaws. When Davis and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), capture the outlaws, they collect reward money to distribute to the ranchers. But Fuzzy, who is in charge of delivering it, loses the money as well as his memory. Now it's up to Davis to set things right and prevent land baron Jim Kirby (George Chesebro) from getting his hands on the cash.

programme.title: Stage to Mesa City
programme.desc: Valiant U.S. Marshal Cheyenne Davis (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his trusty deputy, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are on their way to aid a stagecoach owner who is mired in financial burdens. But, when they arrive and discover he's been murdered, the loyal pair are asked by Margie (Jennifer Holt), his daughter, to seek out his killers and make them pay for their vile crime. The investigation soon leads them to a sneering lawyer (Marshall Reed), who has a mysterious boss.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: Undercover federal marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is suspected by the local sheriff, Jake (George Hayes), of stealing the town's payroll, but his suspicions are sidelined when young Betty Mason (Eleanor Hunt) announces that her father, an important businessman, has been murdered. Without him, supplies will not reach town, and homesteaders will starve. When town leader Malgrove (Edward Peil) offers to buy the locals out, John and Jake get suspicious, and uncover a land-grabbing conspiracy.

programme.title: Ambush Bay
programme.desc: In 1944, Sgt. Steve Corey (Hugh O'Brian) leads a group of U.S. Marines on a covert mission to an island in the Philippines that is occupied by Japanese forces. There, the soldiers learn that the enemy has planted a series of mines to destroy General MacArthur's incoming troops, who are preparing to storm the island. Before the Marines get a chance to relay the information, they suffer a deadly attack, leaving only the valiant Corey and Pfc. James Grenier (James Mitchum) to save the day.

programme.title: Submarine X-1
programme.desc: Cmdr. Richard Bolton was in charge of a submarine that was sunk by a German ship, and he has been blamed for the loss of 50 sailors. Now exonerated of misconduct, he is heading a mission to use minisubs to reach a German battleship commanded by Capt. Erlich. During training, Bolton encounters some of his previous crew members, all of whom harbor grudges against him, which further complicates the already dangerous mission.

programme.title: Tank Battalion
programme.desc: During the Korean War, Sgt. Brad Dunne (Don Kelly) heads a tank battalion consisting of reluctant young recruit Pfc. Danny Collins (Bob Padget) and seasoned soldiers Corp. Corbett (Edward G. Robinson Jr.) and Pfc. Madigan (Frank Gorshin). When guerrillas launch a series of ambushes on a U.S. base camp, Dunne and his men are ordered to lead an offensive against the rebels. But, just as they approach the front lines, a grenade blast disables their tank, stranding them as the enemy approaches.

programme.title: Beach Red
programme.desc: Ordered to help secure a heavily defended Japanese island during World War II, Captain MacDonald (Cornel Wilde) and his Marines land on "Beach Red" and proceed inland against stubborn, murderous resistance. MacDonald is supported by his tough-as-nails gunnery sergeant (Rip Torn), soulful Private Egan (Burr DeBenning) and a group of stalwart Marines who try to block out the horrors that surround them by remembering the women they love back home.

programme.title: Flight From Ashiya
programme.desc: Stationed in Ashiya, Japan, U.S. Air Force Rescue Service members Master Sgt. Mike Takashima (Yul Brynner), Lt. Col. Glenn Stevenson (Richard Widmark) and Lt. John Gregg (George Chakiris) all carry personal demons stemming from a past event. When the orders come down to rescue stranded Japanese survivors of a shipwreck caused by a storm, the three men jump into action. On their way through the still violent storm, each shares the tale from his past that has affected him to this day.

programme.title: One Man's Hero
programme.desc: In 1848, Jon Riley heads a group of Irish-born Roman Catholic soldiers in the U.S. Army. The group faces religious prejudice in the predominantly Protestant military. In the midst of the war against Mexico, Riley and some of his fellow soldiers go to a Catholic Church and are cruelly punished as a result. Because of this, they defect to the Mexican Army, where they meet guerrilla leader Cortina, with whom they forge an unlikely bond.

programme.title: The Gallant Hours
programme.desc: As he retires from the U.S. Navy, Admiral William J. Halsey (James Cagney) recalls the most daunting challenge in his career: the Battle of Guadalcanal in 1942. Ordered to replace a close friend as fleet admiral, Halsey faces a wily and fierce adversary in Japan's Admiral Yamamoto, and spends the grueling months of the campaign confounding expectations of both the enemy and his own staff. Pained by the losses he knows they will endure, Halsey pushes his forces to the brink.

programme.desc: An Irish rebel (Robert Mitchum) blows the whistle on Nazi collaborators in the Irish Republican Army.

programme.title: Salt and Pepper
programme.desc: Christopher Pepper (Peter Lawford) and Charles Salt (Sammy Davis Jr.) are hip Soho nightclub owners enjoying the good life -- until a secret agent turns up dead in their club. They find her diary and, pursuing the case on their own, discover a sinister plot to overthrow the British government, masterminded by a certain Col. Woodstock (John Le Mesurier). Salt and Pepper have a tough time getting anyone to believe their story until Col. Balsom (Ernest Clark) of MI5 hires them to foil the plot.

programme.title: Topkapi
programme.desc: Beautiful thief Elizabeth Lipp (Melina Mercouri) and criminal genius Walter Harper (Maximilian Schell) put together a plan to steal an emerald-encrusted dagger from Istanbul's Topkapi Palace. As part of their crew, they hire small-time hustler Arthur Simon Simpson (Peter Ustinov) to act as their fall guy. When the Turkish secret police capture Simpson at the border, they persuade him to spy on his partners in crime, mistakenly believing that they're Communist agents plotting an assassination.

programme.title: Cul-de-Sac
programme.desc: When on-the-lam crook Richard (Lionel Stander) and his injured partner-in-crime, Albie (Jack MacGowran), seek shelter in a remote castle by the sea, they find themselves confronted by the owners -- George (Donald Pleasence), an eccentric and weak retiree, and his oversexed wife, Teresa (Françoise Dorléac). Richard seizes control of the castle, but, as the criminals are pulled further into the isolated world of the strange couple, a volatile test of wills ensues.

Holmes sets out to investigate.

programme.title: The Man in the Net
programme.desc: Big city advertising artist John Hamilton (Alan Ladd) abandons his career and relocates to a sleepy Connecticut community to paint for himself instead of for a paycheck. But his erratic spouse, Linda (Carolyn Jones), quickly grows bored with her quiet new life and begins to lash out at him. After turning to the bottle, Linda begins to openly insult her husband and even accuses him of beating her. So later, when she goes missing, the locals suspect John of murder and an angry mob comes after him.

programme.title: Lady of Vengeance
programme.desc: When publisher William Marshall (Dennis O'Keefe) learns his young ward Melissa Collins (Eileen Elton) has committed suicide, he sets in motion a plan to murder the man who drove her to kill herself. Mistakenly believing that singer Larry Shaw (Vernon Greeves) is his intended target, Marshall unwittingly seeks help from the man who actually broke Melissa's heart, criminal Emile Karnak (Anton Diffring). When Marshall learns the truth, however, he turns his efforts toward Karnak instead.

programme.title: Four Boys and a Gun
programme.desc: Young toughs will all die in the electric chair unless they tell who killed a policeman during a holdup.

programme.title: The Big Knife
programme.desc: Movie star Charles Castle draws the ire of Hollywood producer Stanley Hoff when he refuses to sign a new seven-year contract. Castle is sick of the low quality of the studio's films and wants to start a new life. While his estranged wife supports him in the decision, Castle's talent agent urges him to reconsider. When Castle continues to be uncooperative, Hoff resorts to blackmail in order to get his way.

programme.title: Behind the Mask
programme.desc: The Shadow (Kane Richmond) tracks a killer to a clip joint and exposes a city editor's racket.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: Dr. Bernard Adrian (Boris Karloff) is researching a way to help a wheelchair-bound patient, Frances (Maris Wrixon), use her legs again. The only way he can achieve this is by procuring spinal fluid from a human. When an ape escapes from a circus, Dr. Adrian kills it in a confrontation and successfully uses its spinal fluid on Frances -- but he needs more. Using the ape's body as a suit, he kills townspeople in a crazed attempt to complete his plan.

programme.title: The Big Boodle

programme.title: One Thrilling Night
programme.desc: Honeymooners (John Beal, Wanda McKay) find gangsters searching for money in their New York hotel room.

programme.title: The Hoodlum Priest
programme.desc: Venturing into some of the roughest slums of St. Louis, Jesuit priest Rev. Charles Dismas Clark (Don Murray) dedicates himself to helping young ex-convicts who are struggling to rejoin a society that fears and rejects them. An especially wrenching case for the Reverend is Billy Lee Jackson (Keir Dullea), a troubled thief whose personal demons constantly tempt him back to a life of crime -- and may ultimately make him pay the highest price for a few desperate decisions.

programme.title: Kid Colter
programme.desc: In the mountains of the Pacific Northwest, young Justin Colter (Jeremy Shamos) gets caught in the middle of a chase between two groups of spies. They kidnap him and eventually leave him for dead in the forest. But Justin's father, Bill (Jim Stafford), trained his boy to survive in the wild. Using the skills taught to him by his father, Justin fights against the harsh elements and wild animals of the mountains to make his way back home and reunite with his worried family.

programme.title: Sea Fury
programme.desc: The first mate (Stanley Baker) of a British salvage boat rivals his captain (Victor McLaglen) for a Spanish girl (Luciana Paluzzi).

programme.title: Some Kind of a Nut
programme.desc: A bank teller loses his job and girlfriend because he refuses to shave off a beard he grew while on vacation.

programme.title: The Captive City
programme.desc: A private investigator informs small-town newspaper editor Jim Austin of corrupt local activity. When the investigator is killed, Austin believes it's an act of revenge, and his own detective work reveals a network of gambling and corruption. Crime boss Murray Sirak controls the whole town, including the police. Sirak answers to his own boss, "Mr. Big," who is seemingly untouchable, but Austin risks his life to expose the truth.

programme.title: Shield for Murder
programme.desc: Corrupt cop Barney Nolan (Edmond O'Brien) is hard up for cash, so he shoots a bookie, relieves him of $25,000 and makes it look like an accident. Unbeknownst to Nolan, however, the entire episode is witnessed by a deaf-mute from across the street. While Nolan struggles to keep the crime a secret from his girlfriend, Patty Winters (Marla English), a series of loose ends pop up, and Nolan soon learns that, although committing a crime is easy, getting away with it is murder.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force.

programme.title: Vice Raid
programme.desc: New York mobsters use a Detroit prostitute (Mamie Van Doren) to set up a vice-squad detective (Richard Coogan).

programme.title: The Big Boodle
programme.desc: Cuban crooks and police chase a casino card dealer (Errol Flynn) for counterfeit pesos and plates.

programme.title: One Thrilling Night
programme.desc: Honeymooners (John Beal, Wanda McKay) find gangsters searching for money in their New York hotel room.

programme.title: The Black Tent
programme.desc: An Englishman (Donald Sinden) learns his army brother (Anthony Steel) married a Bedouin (Anna-Maria Sandri) and fought the Nazis as a guerrilla.

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: Not as a Stranger
programme.desc: Ambitious medical student Lucas Marsh (Robert Mitchum) aspires to being a doctor with his own practice. Unable to fund his studies himself, he woos the warm, supportive nurse Kristina (Olivia de Havilland), who has the financial resources he needs for him to realize his dreams. The couple marries and moves to a small town, where Lucas works as an assistant to Dr. Runkleman (Charles Bickford). However, after a series of betrayals, Lucas is forced to face life without the help of others.

programme.title: Buona Sera, Mrs. Campbell
programme.desc: During World War II, an Italian villager (Gina Lollobrigida) befriends three American soldiers. Later, when unsure which of them fathered the daughter she has, she invents a dead captain named Campbell, declares herself his widow and accepts support checks from all three soldiers. Twenty years later, a reunion unexpectedly brings the three veterans -- and their wives and children -- back to Italy. Mrs. Campbell panics as she endeavors to keep her lively past from her daughter.

programme.title: Violent Playground
programme.desc: Sgt. Truman (Stanley Baker), a policeman who deals with juvenile delinquents, visits the Murphy household after a theft by the young twins, Mary and Patrick. There he meets their older sister, Cathie (Anne Heywood), and soon begins a romantic involvement with her. However, Cathie's brother, Johnnie (David McCallum), is the leader of an infamous local gang, and doesn't like to see his sister with a cop. Gradually, Truman starts to see a link between Johnnie and a string of local arsons.

programme.title: The Fugitive Kind
programme.desc: When drifter Valentine Xavier (Marlon Brando) arrives in a southern town, he catches the eye of the married Lady Torrance (Anna Magnani) and the oversexed alcoholic, Carol Cutrere (Joanne Woodward). Both vie for his attention, with Lady Torrance emerging victorious, offering Xavier employment in her general store, while her cancer-stricken husband is bedridden upstairs. After impregnating Lady Torrance and butting heads with friends of her husband, Xavier must make a crucial decision.

programme.title: So Young, So Bad
programme.desc: At the Elmview Corrective School for Girls, the facility's warden, Mr. Riggs (Cecil Clovelly), abuses prisoners and justifies his actions as strict discipline. Dr. John H. Jason (Paul Henreid), the school's head psychologist, and Ruth Levering (Catherine McLeod), an assistant, view Riggs' actions as unethical, and believe he's driving the prisoners further toward delinquency. They're proven correct when several girls at the school attempt an escape.

programme.title: Attack on the Iron Coast
programme.desc: With D-Day fast approaching, the Allied forces of World War II prepare to strike a number of strategic Nazi bases. Leading one such attack, Maj. Jamie Wilson (Lloyd Bridges) concocts a risky plan for what is quickly becoming a suicide mission. With a reckless streak that has cost the lives of many men, Wilson faces the opposition of Capt. Owen Franklin (Andrew Keir), whose son was killed in Wilson's last mission. However, Franklin must put aside his feelings when he is ordered to join the major.

programme.title: A Story of David: The Hunted
programme.desc: Renowned for his courageous deeds as a youth when he slew Goliath, David (Jeff Chandler) inadvertently incurs the wrath of King Saul (Basil Sydney), who is jealous of the hero's popularity. In order to provide peace of mind for the Israelite king, Saul's scheming counselor, Doeg (Peter Arne), encourages the ruler to have David killed. David, aided by his friend Jonathan (David Knight), who is Saul's own son, attempts to survive without overtly clashing with his own people.

programme.title: Born Losers
programme.desc: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy.

programme.title: The Pride and the Passion
programme.desc: During the Napoleonic Wars, retreating Spanish forces shove a powerful cannon off a cliff to prevent the French from stealing it. The British send Capt. Anthony Turnbull (Cary Grant) to help the Spanish recapture it. When he arrives in Spain, Turnbull finds the cannon secured by Spanish rebels. As Turnbull and the rebel leader Miguel (Frank Sinatra) struggle to transport the cumbersome cannon through the mountains, the British officer falls for beautiful Spaniard Juana (Sophia Loren).

programme.title: Woman of Straw
programme.desc: Charles Richmond (Ralph Richardson), a ruthless millionaire on his deathbed, has decided to leave his entire fortune to charity. programme.title: Park Row
programme.desc: Reporter Phineas Mitchell (Gene Evans) works at a successful newspaper, the Star, but does not respect the publication. After sharing his thoughts about a moral and just newspaper at a local pub, he inspires his colleagues to join him in starting a new paper, the Globe, which is an instant hit. However, the publisher of the Star, Charity Hackett (Mary Welch), will not give up her readership easily and orders sabotage on the Globe -- even as Phineas begins to fall for her.

programme.title: The Square Peg
programme.desc: A World War II street laborer (Norman Wisdom) uses his resemblance to a Nazi officer when he is drafted into the British army and captured by German troops.

programme.title: Albino Alligator
programme.desc: When a robbery in New Orleans ends in disaster, the mercurial burglar Dova escapes with his cohorts to a seedy, nearby bar. Capturing all those inside, the criminals trade barbs with the establishment's feisty bartender Janet Boudreaux. The pub becomes highly volatile, however, when the police encircle it; as it turns out, they were already there surveilling another of the bar's patrons, a suspected illicit arms trafficker named Guy Foucard.

programme.title: The Last Time I Saw Archie
programme.desc: As World War II winds down, supply pilots at a stateside military base are left with few duties. Cocky Pvt. Bill Bowers (Jack Webb), Archie gets entangled with a pair of local women, Peggy (Martha Hyer) and Cindy (France Nuyen) -- one of whom might be passing secrets to the Japanese.

programme.title: If It's Tuesday, It Still Must Be Belgium
programme.desc: Tourists in Europe join their bus driver (Claude Akins) on a search for his daughter, kidnapped by a circus knife-thrower (Bruce Weitz).

programme.title: Phantom Killer
programme.desc: A district attorney (Dick Purcell) quits to prove the guilt of an acquitted killer (John Hamilton) who cannot hear or speak.

programme.title: Article 99
programme.desc: Dr. Richard Sturgess (Ray Liotta) leads a team of compassionate doctors at a veteran's hospital. Along with Drs. To succeed, the staff may have to bend the rules and circumvent the villainous "Article 99," a bureaucratic loophole that prevents veterans from receiving the benefits they deserve.

programme.title: Billie
programme.desc: Billie (Patty Duke) is a tomboy who loves sports. When the high school track coach (Charles Lane) sees her run, he asks her to join the school team. Her inclusion in the formerly all-male team causes quite a stir, especially with her father (Jim Backus). He is typically supportive of Billie, but now he worries that her shocking behavior will cost him his bid for mayor. Nervously, he starts setting Billie up with dates, unaware that she has a crush on her classmate, Mike (Warren Berlinger).

programme.title: The First Time
programme.desc: Searching for a Canadian bordello leads three teenage boys to a British beauty who scares them.

programme.title: Cul-de-Sac
programme.desc: When on-the-lam crook Richard (Lionel Stander) and his injured partner-in-crime, Albie (Jack MacGowran), seek shelter in a remote castle by the sea, they find themselves confronted by the owners -- George (Donald Pleasence), an eccentric and weak retiree, and his oversexed wife, Teresa (Françoise Dorléac). Richard seizes control of the castle, but, as the criminals are pulled further into the isolated world of the strange couple, a volatile test of wills ensues.

programme.title: The Monkey Hustle
programme.desc: Slick Chicago street hustler Big Daddy Foxx (Yaphet Kotto) lives comfortably off petty confidence scams that he pulls with the help of loyal teenage acolytes Baby D' (Kirk Calloway), Tiny (Donn Harper) and Player (Thomas Carter). His business is jeopardized, however, when he runs afoul of neighborhood racketeer Goldie (Rudy Ray Moore). Their rivalry escalates until the threat of a freeway being built through their neighborhood obliges them to cooperate in order to fight city hall.

programme.title: Drum
programme.desc: A slaver (Warren Oates) buys Drum (Ken Norton), a bordello queen's (Silvia Pinal) son, in the 1860s New Orleans.

programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: After a robbery in Harlem turns into a scene of mass murder, promising young black police officer William Pope (Yaphet Kotto) is assigned to the case, along with surly, prejudiced Italian-American cop Frank Mattelli (Anthony Quinn). The pair clashes during their tense investigation as they try to track down the three suspects and apprehend them. Also searching for the fugitives is ruthless mobster Nick D'Salvio (Tony Franciosa), who will stop at nothing to retrieve the stolen money.

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: Bounty hunter Mack "Truck" Turner (Isaac Hayes) almost always finds his target, but his latest prize -- a pimp called Gator (Paul Harris) -- is killed while Turner is chasing him. Gator's girl, Dorinda (Nichelle Nichols), vows to avenge his death and offers ownership of her successful call-girl operation to anyone who can knock off Turner. Upscale pimp Harvard Blue (Yaphet Kotto) steps in, upping the ante with professional assassins. Turner, however, isn't going down easily.

programme.title: Friday Foster
programme.desc: On assignment from her editor, photographer Friday Foster (Pam Grier) travels to an airport to capture a few shots of the richest black man in the United States (Thalmus Rasulala). But it turns out Foster isn't the only one taking shots as she witnesses -- and photographs -- an assassination attempt on her subject. With definitive evidence in her possession, she also becomes a target of the assassins. Joining a private eye (Yaphet Kotto), Foster sets out to discover the truth behind the attempt.

programme.title: Census Taker
programme.desc: Fed up with his intrusiveness, members of a family shoot a census taker and try to hide his body from a detective.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: Walter Whitney is a successful executive who resides in an upscale Southern California suburb. Like all of his friends and neighbors, Walter is white, and he is shocked when he learns he has a son he never knew about -- black teen Roger Porter (Denzel Washington). Despite his surprise, Walter welcomes Roger into his home; unfortunately, the less accepting Mrs. Whitney (Susan Saint James) boots both of them out of the house, and Walter's racist boss fires him, leaving him in a tough spot.

programme.title: Amazing Grace
programme.desc: A feisty old woman (Moms Mabley) forces moral support on a big-city candidate (Moses Gunn) for mayor.

programme.title: Five on the Black Hand Side
programme.desc: Mr. Brooks (Leonard Jackson) is an African-American barbershop owner who runs his household with an iron fist. One day, however, Mrs. Brooks (Clarice Taylor) tires of his stern approach and embraces a nonconformist attitude that's more in line with that of their children, including the philosophical Booker T. (D'Urville Martin) and Gideon (Glynn Turman), a black militant. Soon a battle of wills erupts in the Brooks household, and no one is going to readily back down.

programme.title: The Angel Levine
programme.desc: Unable to work due to a back injury, elderly Jewish tailor Morris Mishkin spends his days caring for his ill wife and wishing for happiness. After Morris sees a man die in the street, the man returns to Morris claiming to be a Jewish angel named Alexander Levine, who must perform a miracle within 24 hours to be confirmed as an angel. As his wife's health improves, Morris shows Alexander that renewing his faith may not be so easy.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Eve of Destruction
programme.desc: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

programme.title: J.D.'s Revenge
programme.desc: Although notorious New Orleans gangster J.D. Walker (David McKnight) is shot and killed in the 1940s, his spirit remains restless for three decades, until a hypnotist's supernatural nightclub act allows him to take over the body of Isaac (Glynn Turman), a mild-mannered law student. After inhabiting Isaac, Walker decides to hunt down the Rev. Elija Bliss (Louis Gossett Jr.), a former criminal who helped the authorities find and assassinate the mobster years ago.

programme.title: Act of Vengeance
programme.desc: Five women learn martial arts in order to punish a rapist (Peter Brown) who wears a hockey mask.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Growing up on the tough streets of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) has his life made even harder by John McKinney (Art Lund), a crooked cop who breaks the boy's leg, crippling him for life. Drawing on his anger at the racism he faces on a daily basis, Tommy grows up to become the crime kingpin of Harlem. Now that he has the power, he aims to take down New York's Mafia bosses -- and also get bloody revenge on his nemesis, McKinney, no matter what the cost.

programme.title: Mandela
programme.desc: This documentary follows the beloved South African leader Nelson Mandela from his early days to his presidency, depicting South Africa and its turbulent years during apartheid control, which was brought to an end in 1994 with the nation's democratic election of Mandela as president. Focus is placed on Mandela's early education, his personal relationships, and his political activism for the African National Congress, which led to his 27-year imprisonment for sabotage.

programme.title: Getting Even
programme.desc: Rival Texas chemical magnates (Edward Albert, Joe Don Baker) hold Dallas hostage over nerve gas stolen from the Soviets.

programme.title: Mercenary Fighters
programme.desc: An emerging African nation pits soldiers of fortune (Peter Fonda, Reb Brown, Ron O'Neal) against rebels blocking a dam project.

programme.title: Windprints
programme.desc: Young South African cameraman Anton van Heerden and aging British journalist Charles Rutherford team up to gather information about an apparent Namibian serial killer. In a country ruled by a minority white government, Nhadiep seems only to murder other blacks. His proximity to the strange and horrifying crimes causes Anton to contemplate his role as a privileged white man in a continent where millions of blacks are oppressed.

programme.title: For Us, the Living
programme.desc: During the civil rights movement of the '50s and '60s in Mississippi, Medgar Evers (Howard E. Rollins Jr.) rose from being an insurance agent to become one of the most integral activists of the era. From boycotting white merchants in the mid '50s to being a key figure in desegregating the University of Mississippi in 1962, Evers met success, and with it many enemies. When racists swarm his house, his life and the lives of his wife (Irene Cara) and children are threatened.

programme.title: The Perez Family

United by their last name and a mutual resolve to emigrate, Dorita and Juan agree to play along. programme.title: Live: Hot Stove

What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. While she has no idea who her new husband is, her longtime admirer, Norval Jones (Eddie Bracken), seizes the opportunity to help. When Trudy's cop father (William Demarest) catches wind of the situation, however, wacky misunderstandings follow, with the well-meaning Norval on the wrong side of the law.

As he frantically tries to unravel the mystery behind his own impending demise, his sleuthing leads him to a group of crooked businessmen and another murder.

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons
programme.desc: The Johnstons -- all seven -- of Forsyth, Ga., are the subjects of this reality-documentary series. The brood, TLC says, are "the world's largest known family of achondroplasia dwarfs." Achondroplasia is a genetic disorder of bone growth, but the series demonstrates that size only matters in the amount of love the Johnstons provide. Trent, a grounds supervisor at a local college, and housewife Amber have two biological children -- Jonah and Elizabeth -- while Anna, Alex and Emma were adopted from Russia, Korea and China, respectively. Episodes deal with everything from high-drama soccer tryouts to a disastrous attempt at a "birds and bees" discussion, all framed by the family tackling a massive renovation of their 6,000-square-foot, circa 1891 home.

programme.sub-title: José Pañeda: La leyenda hispana tras el micrófono del Heat de Miami
programme.desc: José Pañeda, pionero de los Miami Heat desde 1989, es la emblemática voz en español que ha narrado los tres títulos de campeonato de la franquicia, diez Finales de la NBA y numerosos eventos internacionales. Pañeda fue el primer comentarista hispano en alcanzar los 1 000 partidos consecutivos, así como el primero en ser nombrado Comentarista Deportivo del Año de Florida. Elizabeth Pérez visita a esta leyenda del periodismo deportivo en el estadio de los Heat.

programme.desc: Life has changed drastically for thunder buddies John (Mark Wahlberg), now a bachelor, and best pal Ted (Seth MacFarlane), now married to the woman (Jessica Barth) of his dreams. Problems arise when the couple decide to adopt a child, but the law declares Ted to be property and not a person. programme.title: Ted
programme.desc: When John Bennett (Mark Wahlberg) was a little boy, he made a wish that Ted (Seth MacFarlane), his beloved teddy bear, would come alive. Thirty years later, foul-mouthed Ted is still John's constant companion, much to the chagrin of Lori (Mila Kunis), John's girlfriend. Though Lori's displeasure is exacerbated by the pair's constant consumption of beer and weed, she's not the one who's most disappointed with John; it may take the intervention of John's boyhood toy to help him grow up at last.

programme.title: Slo Pitch
programme.desc: As Captain of the slo pitch beer league team, the Brovaries, Joanne is determined to make this season count, but the team just can't get their act together. Joanne's hot lawyer fiancé is so bad that kicking her off the team is the only solution. Stoner-bisexual Ann is sleeping with TWO members of the Brovaries' biggest rival team, and disgraced ex pro player Mel has sunk into a deep depression. If all that wasn't enough, German beer hound Boris needs to find a wife or face imminent deportation before playoffs, and rookie Lee spends more time with her glove on her head making Tik Tok videos than catching anything. The Brovaries need to come together if they're going to make it past the drama, save a marriage, fake a marriage, and beat their rival team, The Blue Gays. There may not be any money, trophies or sponsorship deals up for grabs, but for the Brovaries, slo pitch is life or death. Well, maybe for Joanne anyway. Everyone else is just in it for the beer. And the girls.

The Brovaries need to come together if they're going to make it past the drama, save a marriage, fake a marriage, and beat their rival team, The Blue Gays. There may not be any money, trophies or sponsorship deals up for grabs, but for the Brovaries, slo pitch is life or death. Well, maybe for Joanne anyway. Everyone else is just in it for the beer. And the girls.

programme.title: Let's Make a Deal
programme.desc: CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. The program won a Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Award for Outstanding Original Song in 2014 for "30,000 Reasons to Love Me," composed by Cat Gray and performed by Wayne Brady.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.desc: Video game designer Allegra Geller (Jennifer Jason Leigh) has created a virtual reality game called eXistenZ. After a crazed fan attempts to kill her, Allegra goes on the run with Ted (Jude Law), a young businessman who falls into the role of bodyguard. In an attempt to save her game, Allegra implants into Ted's body the video game pod that carries a damaged copy of eXistenZ. Allegra and Ted engage in a series of experiences that blur the lines between fantasy and reality.

programme.desc: Navin (Steve Martin) believes he was born a poor black child in Mississippi. He is, however, actually white. Upon figuring this out, he heads north to St. Louis to find himself. programme.title: A Severed Head
programme.desc: Antonia Lynch-Gibbon (Lee Remick), wife of upper-crust wine dealer Martin (Ian Holm), falls in love with her husband's best friend, noted psychiatrist Palmer Anderson (Richard Attenborough). While both Palmer and Antonia would like to remain in Martin's life, he has some secrets of his own -- namely, a mistress called Georgie (Jennie Linden), whom his womanizing brother (Clive Revill) also desires. All the while, Palmer's sister (Claire Bloom) seems to know everyone's business.

programme.title: Slap Shot
programme.desc: In the small New England town of Charlestown, the local mill is about to lay off 10,000 workers. The town's minor league hockey team, the Charlestown Chiefs, is doing no better. After years of failure, this will be the team's last season. Exasperated player and coach Reggie Dunlop (Paul Newman) lets the club's recent acquisitions, the Hanson Brothers, play. The brothers' actively violent and thuggish style of play excites the fans. Dunlop retools the team, using violence to draw big crowds.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: A totalitarian future holds an annual nationally televised event in which two children from each of its regions fight to the death until only one remains. A teenage girl takes her younger sister's place in the games and must pit her wits against the deadly combat skills of her rivals. Sci-fi adventure based on Suzanne Collins' novel, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson, Woody Harrelson and Elizabeth Banks.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen's victory in a televised death match makes her a focus for revolution against the totalitarian nation she lives in. The rulers of the regime plot to crush dissent with a new series of games, in which past champions battle it out. Sci-fi adventure sequel based on the second book in Suzanne Collins' trilogy of novels, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Liam Hemsworth, Donald Sutherland and Philip Seymour Hoffman.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen is brought to a secretive underground society following the destruction of the televised deathmatch. She becomes the figurehead of a revolution against the despotic Panem regime, while her friend Peeta remains a captive of its tyrannical president. Part one of the two-part conclusion to the sci-fi adventure series, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Julianne Moore and Donald Sutherland.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
programme.desc: The civilisation of Panem is consumed by a bloody civil war. Reluctant rebel leader Katniss Everdeen leads a band of her allies on a mission to end the conflict at one stroke by assassinating the despotic President Snow - but faces many dangers as she closes in on her target. Conclusion of the sci-fi adventure series based on Suzanne Collins' novels, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Donald Sutherland and Philip Seymour Hoffman in his final role.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Christmas Classics
programme.desc: A festive special highlights a number of classic Christmas films, from the Grinch's Christmas mischief to the romance of Last Christmas.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: A mischievous trio of talking chipmunks invade a struggling songwriter's home. When the furry critters demonstrate a remarkable talent for singing, he agrees to help them find fame and fortune. However, an unscrupulous record company boss has other plans. Children's comedy, starring Jason Lee and David Cross, with the voices of Justin Long, Matthew Gray Gubler and Jesse McCartney.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: The singing trio are left in the care of their manager's nephew and try to save a school's music programme by winning a battle-of-the-bands competition. However, they encounter fierce rivalry from another group of musical rodents. Comedy, starring Zachary Levi, Jason Lee and David Cross, with the voices of Justin Long and Christina Applegate.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: The singing rodents cause mayhem while performing on a tropical cruise, before they find themselves stranded on a desert island. As they search for a way to get back to civilisation, it becomes clear that they are not alone. Comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Jenny Slate, with the voices of Justin Long, Matthew Gray Gubler and Jesse McCartney.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: The singing rodents mistakenly come to the conclusion that their human friend Dave intends to get rid of them when he proposes to his girlfriend in Miami. With only three days until Dave pops the question, the trio embark on a desperate road trip across America to sabotage his romantic plans. Family comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Kimberly Williams-Paisley.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: A mischievous trio of talking chipmunks invade a struggling songwriter's home. When the furry critters demonstrate a remarkable talent for singing, he agrees to help them find fame and fortune. However, an unscrupulous record company boss has other plans. Children's comedy, starring Jason Lee and David Cross, with the voices of Justin Long, Matthew Gray Gubler and Jesse McCartney.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: The singing trio are left in the care of their manager's nephew and try to save a school's music programme by winning a battle-of-the-bands competition. However, they encounter fierce rivalry from another group of musical rodents. Comedy, starring Zachary Levi, Jason Lee and David Cross, with the voices of Justin Long and Christina Applegate.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: The singing rodents cause mayhem while performing on a tropical cruise, before they find themselves stranded on a desert island. As they search for a way to get back to civilisation, it becomes clear that they are not alone. Comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Jenny Slate, with the voices of Justin Long, Matthew Gray Gubler and Jesse McCartney.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: The singing rodents mistakenly come to the conclusion that their human friend Dave intends to get rid of them when he proposes to his girlfriend in Miami. Family comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Kimberly Williams-Paisley.

programme.title: Madeleine McCann: Searching for the Prime Suspect
programme.desc: 18 years after Madeleine McCann's disappearance from a holiday apartment in Portugal, the mystery remains unsolved and the investigation is still active - German prosecutors recently made headlines by confirming that Christian Brueckner, the man they've long believed responsible, is set to be released from prison with no charges imminent in relation to Madeleine's abduction and suspected murder. Why are German authorities so certain of his guilt and yet still unable to prove it? Criminologist Dr Graham Hill, a former senior Met detective who was in Portugal during the early stages of the investigation into Madeleine McCann's disappearance and assisted local police, returns to Praia da Luz for the first time in this powerful documentary - by revisiting the scene of her disappearance and unpicking a criminal history, Dr Hill examines the case against the man who remains the prime suspect and who has consistently denied any involvement in Madeleine McCann's disappearance.

Après le naufrage de leur voilier dans une brume étrange, neuf écologistes survivent sur une île déserte où des phénomènes mystérieux les déchirent.

programme.desc: Présentée par Jean-Pierre Gagick, Automoto vous donne rendez-vous chaque dimanche au cœur de l'actualité automobile. Salons, courses historiques et événements populaires, l'émission est partout là où s'écrit la passion automobile. Sur sa base d'essai située sur le très secret circuit de Mortefontaine, Automoto teste les voitures de sport et met à l'épreuve toutes les nouveautés, sans concession ! Derrière le volant, vous retrouverez les pilotes historiques de l'émission comme Anthony Beltoise ou Bruce Jouanny, rejoints la saison dernière par Sarah Bovy. Côté motos, les habitués d'Automoto pourront également retrouver Bader Benlekehal. En parallèle, l'émission continuera de proposer une large diversité de sujets et de reportages : rubrique pratique, essais, comparatifs, sports mécaniques, vintage...

Au programme : les résumés de 2 affiches, la nouvelle rubrique le Multiplex consacrée aux 4 rencontres du samedi soir, des reportages, des coulisses, des portraits et des interviews exclusives pour une couverture élargie et plus immersive de la Ligue 1. Cette saison,Téléfoot ira également au plus près de la saison des Bleus et de son nouveau sélectionneur, Zinédine Zidane.

Enquête exclusive
programme.sub-title: BAC Paris : au cœur de l’anti-crime
programme.desc:
Courses-poursuites, vols avec violence, trafics de drogue, agressions, homicides, la Brigade Anticriminalité de Paris (BAC 75N) est sur tous les fronts. En civil ou en uniforme, les policiers de cette unité sont des spécialistes des interpellations en flagrant délit. Ils interviennent partout dans Paris, nuit et jour, 24 heures sur 24. 
Pendant plusieurs mois, nos équipes ont obtenu l’autorisation exceptionnelle de suivre la BAC de Paris. Sa mission principale : protéger les Parisiens face à des délinquants de mieux en mieux organisés et qui, fait nouveau, n’ont plus peur de la police. D’autant qu’à Paris, vols, agressions et dégradations ont bondi de 10 % ces deux dernières années (+50 % pour les vols à la tire !).
Aujourd’hui, les hommes et les femmes de la BAC sont plus que de « simples » policiers de terrain. Pour gérer au mieux la violence dans les rues de Paris, ils s’entraînent avec la BRI, la célèbre Brigade de Recherche et d’Intervention. Désormais, ils sont équipés de fusils d'assaut HK G36, des armes jusque-là réservées aux forces d’intervention spéciales et aux unités d’élite. 
Après plusieurs années à la brigade des réseaux ferrés, Lawa, 36 ans, vient d’intégrer la BAC 75N. Chaque nuit, la jeune femme se fond dans la masse au milieu des pickpockets et des dealers. Son seul mot d’ordre : voir sans être vue. Son quotidien : de longues heures de filature avant les interpellations des délinquants en flagrant délit. 
À 36 ans, Arnaud a déjà six ans d’expérience au sein de la BAC. Réputé pour son sang-froid et son courage, le brigadier sera confronté à des situations tendues face à des agresseurs d’une extrême violence et des victimes en état de choc. Malgré la dureté de son métier, Arnaud reste passionné par son travail. Pour faire comprendre sa vie de policier à la jeune génération, il partage les vidéos de ses interventions les plus spectaculaires sur les réseaux sociaux. 
À la tête de la BAC 75N, Frédéric, 45 ans. Commissaire, fils et petit-fils de policier, il a appris à gérer les situations les plus explosives. Contrairement à d’autres commissaires, ce chef intervient sur le terrain, aux côtés de ses troupes. Notamment lors de ces immenses fêtes sauvages organisées en plein Paris où des rixes éclatent.

programme.title: Enquête exclusive
programme.sub-title: Trump et son clan : hold-up sur la Maison-Blanche
programme.desc:
Des milliards de dollars amassés, une Maison-Blanche transformée en palais et une famille qui fait prospérer ses affaires au sommet de l'État, depuis son retour au pouvoir, Donald Trump gouverne les États-Unis comme son propre empire. Mais jusqu'où le 47ᵉ président des États-Unis peut-il mettre la présidence au service de son clan ? À la veille du résultat des élections de mi-mandat, enquête sur la dérive autocratique de Donald Trump.
Alors que l'inflation continue de frapper le pays, les affaires de la famille Trump prospèrent. La fortune de Donald Trump dépasse désormais les six milliards de dollars. Ses fils Eric et Donald Jr. développent leurs projets immobiliers à l'étranger et leurs activités dans les cryptomonnaies. Le mélange des genres entre business et diplomatie est total. Cette confusion entre pouvoir et intérêts privés inquiète jusque dans l'ancien entourage du président. Ty Cobb, avocat de la Maison-Blanche lors du premier mandat, dénonce un homme prêt à tout pour s'enrichir et se maintenir au pouvoir. Pour le psychologue John Gartner, qui analyse ses prises de parole depuis dix ans, le culte de sa propre personne a des conséquences bien réelles sur sa manière de gouverner.
Alors que les Américains s'inquiètent de leur pouvoir d'achat, leur président affiche les attributs d'un souverain. Dans le Bureau ovale, la décoration a bien changé depuis son retour au pouvoir. Les dorures s'accumulent. Une salle de bal de plus de 8 000 m², largement financée par le contribuable américain, doit bientôt venir compléter le palais présidentiel. Pour ses quatre-vingts ans, Trump a même fait transformer la pelouse de la Maison-Blanche en arène de MMA. Le président se pose en empereur romain, adoubé par des pasteurs évangéliques qui le déclarent « choisi par Dieu ».
Et ceux qui lui résistent s'exposent à son courroux. Les juges qui contrarient le président sont publiquement insultés, tandis que les menaces de mort contre les magistrats fédéraux ont bondi de près de 60 %. Des campagnes d'intimidation dignes de méthodes mafieuses sont utilisées pour les traquer, visant même leurs familles.

programme.desc: Des candidats vont tenter leur chance pour dénicher les mots et expressions cachés, tout en espérant décrocher les plus gros gains offerts par la roue de la fortune. Mais attention, ils devront éviter la redoutable banqueroute et les autres pièges qu’elle réserve. Chaque jour, trois candidats s'affrontent à travers cinq manches, durant lesquelles ils doivent résoudre une énigme en découvrant un mot ou des expressions. Lors de la finale, il peut remporter jusqu'à 20 000 euros ou un voyage, à condition de résoudre une ultime énigme en seulement 10 secondes !

programme.title: La roue de la fortune
programme.desc: Des candidats vont tenter leur chance pour dénicher les mots et expressions cachés, tout en espérant décrocher les plus gros gains offerts par la roue de la fortune. Mais attention, ils devront éviter la redoutable banqueroute et les autres pièges qu’elle réserve. Chaque jour, trois candidats s'affrontent à travers cinq manches, durant lesquelles ils doivent résoudre une énigme en découvrant un mot ou des expressions. Trouver une consonne leur rapporte de l'argent, tandis que les voyelles sont payantes. À la fin de la cinquième manche, celui ayant amassé le plus d'argent accède à la finale, ce qui lui offre le droit de revenir le lendemain. Lors de la finale, il peut remporter jusqu'à 20 000 euros ou un voyage, à condition de résoudre une ultime énigme en seulement 10 secondes !

programme.title: Quel est l'âge de votre cerveau ?
programme.desc:
Vous connaissez votre âge sur le papier, mais savez-vous quel âge a vraiment votre cerveau ? Dans ce quiz familial, 100 candidats et 4 célébrités relèvent le défi : répondre à 40 questions ludiques et scientifiques pour calculer leur âge cérébral.
Présenté par Olivier Minne, ce programme vous permet de mesurer vos capacités cognitives en même temps que les participants. Enfants, parents et grands-parents peuvent jouer ensemble et comparer leurs résultats. Bonne nouvelle : l'âge cérébral n'est pas figé. Il évolue avec le temps et peut s'améliorer grâce à l'entraînement, la curiosité et la stimulation intellectuelle.
Sur le plateau, le Dr Steven Laureys, neurologue de renommée mondiale et directeur du GIGA Consciousness de l'Université de Liège, décrypte le fonctionnement du cerveau et martèle un message crucial : "Prenez soin de votre cerveau".
Alors, votre cerveau sera-t-il plus ou moins âgé que vous ?

programme.title: La France a un incroyable talent
programme.desc: À l’issue des auditions, ils ne sont plus que 30 candidats en lice : 24 sélectionnés par le jury et 6 qualifiés grâce aux Golden Buzzers. Cette saison, le direct débarque dès les quarts. Pour cette première soirée, dix talents aux univers radicalement opposés vont s'affronter. À l’arrivée, quatre places seulement pour la demi-finale.\r\nHabitués à convaincre Hélène Ségara, Marianne James, Éric Antoine et Sugar Sammy, les candidats trouvent face à eux un 5e juré d'exception et un invité de marque qui dispose de son propre Golden Buzzer : Joyca, créateur de contenu, beatmaker, DJ, compositeur et producteur.\r\nLes téléspectateurs pourront eux aussi sauver un candidat grâce à leur vote et lui permettre de poursuivre l’aventure. Alors, qui décrochera son billet pour la demi-finale ? Qui déclenchera le Golden Buzzer de Joyca ? Et qui réussira à gagner les faveurs du public ?

programme.title: Le meilleur pâtissier
programme.desc:
Au programme pour cette première semaine de concours :

La revisite proposée par Cyril Lignac : le roulé
Les candidats devront réaliser un roulé à leur image. 

Le défi de Norbert Tarayre : le castella cake
Pour cette première épreuve technique, les pâtissiers devront réaliser un castella cake en forme d’ourson. Si Norbert a donné aux candidats tous les ingrédients et mesures, il s’est amusé à enregistrer la recette à triple allure. De quoi faire tourner les candidats en bourrique !

L’épreuve créative de Roxane : le gâteau réconfort
Pour cette première épreuve créative, les pâtissiers devront présenter au jury un gâteau qui les réconforte : trompe-l’œil oreiller, couette ou encore animal de compagnie. Les pâtissiers ne manqueront pas d’imagination pour régaler le jury.

programme.title: Echappées belles
programme.desc: Avec ses énergies renouvelables, ses écoquartiers et sa gestion durable des ressources, le Danemark est un modèle d'écologie. Jérôme Pitorin s'attache à comprendre comment le pays a su bâtir une telle harmonie entre nature, modernité et identité forte et à décrypter ce qui fait la singularité du modèle danois.

programme.title: Nus et culottés
programme.desc: Nans et Mouts partent d'une grotte dans le nord du Lot avec un objectif très particulier : rencontrer un inconnu et l'accompagner dans la réalisation de son rêve.

programme.title: Maghreb-Orient Express
programme.sub-title: Rayess Bek, Vincent Heneine, Amina Damerdji

programme.title: Vroum
programme.desc: Laurent Quembre rencontre deux frères qui restaurent une populaire Renault 4 L, tandis que Michel Jérôme suit un retraité qui remet à neuf une mythique Alpine des années 1980.

programme.title: Partir autrement entre amis
programme.desc: Sébastien Delorme et Jeff Boudreault explorent le Costa Rica. Au programme : yoga, labyrinthe méditatif, bain de boue et découverte des secrets de longévité à Nicoya.

programme.title: Le point
programme.desc: "Dans la mire de Pékin". Le 26 novembre 2022, le corps de Hua Yong est repêché en Colombie-Britannique. Un exemple d'intimidation du gouvernement chinois pour faire taire des dissidents qui vivent au Canada. "La bécasse d'Amérique". Etant presque invisible à l'oeil nu, les chercheurs utilisent le son de sa parade nuptiale pour repérer la bécasse d'Amérique.

programme.title: Mission info
programme.desc: Où vont nos poubelles ? Myriam recueille les questions des enfants et suit le trajet de nos déchets, de la poubelle jusqu'à l'incinérateur, la décharge ou le centre de recyclage. Avec quels effets sur la confiance du public dans le journalisme ?

programme.title: Twist

programme.desc: Le Rialto est constitué de l'Erberia, un marché proposant des fruits et légumes, de la Beccaria, une halle aux viandes, et de la Pescheria, un marché aux poissons.

programme.title: Food Markets
programme.sub-title: Le ventre de Dijon : Les Halles
programme.desc: Dijon est particulièrement réputée pour sa gastronomie. Quatre jours par semaine, son marché couvert invite les gourmets à déambuler au milieu des stands.

programme.title: Food Markets
programme.desc: Dans la ville portuaire de Hambourg, l'Isemarkt est une véritable institution. Caché sous les rails du métro, il s'étend sur plus d'un kilomètre.

Karambolage

programme.title: Sphère5
programme.desc: Et si enfin on prenait le temps de penser plutôt que de réagir ? Dans un paysage saturé de prises de parole rapides et formatées, SPHERE5 propose une alternative rare : des conversations longues, profondes et sincères autour des grandes questions de notre époque. Ophélie Meunier et Carole Juge-Llewellyn ont imaginé et créé ce programme ensemble. Chaque conversation est préparée sur mesure, afin de créer un échange profond et sincère.

programme.title: Déco ou négo *2015
programme.desc: La famille Charles n'arrive pas à décider si elle veut garder sa maison de trois chambres à Birmingham. Richard pense que leur maison est en parfait état, et que ce qui n'est pas cassé n'a donc pas besoin d'être réparé, mais Carla la déteste.

programme.title: Déco ou négo *2015
programme.desc: Kirstie et Phil vont à la rencontre de James et Graham, qui n'arrivent pas à se mettre d'accord sur l'avenir de leur cottage du XVIIe siècle à Cranleigh, dans le Surrey.

programme.title: Déco ou négo *2015
programme.desc: Dave et Amy vivent dans une villa victorienne. Si Dave apprécie le charme de leur maison en pierre, Amy déplore son manque de fonctionnalité.

programme.title: Déco ou négo *2015
programme.desc: Gareth et Tina possèdent leur propriété à Londres depuis dix ans. Tina aime être à quelques pas de son travail et des écoles mais Gareth veut du changement.

programme.title: Au coeur du crime
programme.sub-title: Meurtre chez les gens du voyage
programme.desc: Dans la nuit du 14 février 2016, au sein d'un camp des gens du voyage, Raynald Barguet, 23 ans, est réveillé par un mystérieux appel. A l'autre bout du fil, une voix lui demande de sortir de sa caravane immédiatement. A peine dehors, le jeune homme est mortellement touché d'une balle en pleine poitrine. L'enquête révèle qu'une rivalité sentimentale serait à l'origine de l'assassinat.

programme.title: Au coeur du crime
programme.sub-title: Affaire Beaugendre : les mystérieuses lettres de Madame G
programme.desc: Le 20 décembre 2012, Aurélie Barbot, 29 ans, est tuée d'une balle en pleine tête, sur le porche de sa maison de Val-d'Izé, en Ille-et-Vilaine. Sébastien Beaugendre, son ex-mari, est rapidement soupçonné, malgré des lettres anonymes d'un corbeau s'accusant du crime et arrivées fort à propos, mais dont les enquêteurs pensent qu'il en est l'auteur.

programme.title: Au coeur du crime
programme.sub-title: Meurtre au paradis : les mystérieuses vacances d'Alicia Faye
programme.desc: Le 13 mars 2021, Alicia Faye, une jeune femme originaire de Bordeaux, est retrouvée morte d'une balle entre les deux yeux dans un quartier populaire de Cayenne. Pour les parents d'Alicia, à la douleur s'ajoute l'incompréhension. En effet, ils croyaient leur fille à Paris pour un week-end entre copines. Que faisait-elle de l'autre côté de l'océan Atlantique et comment a-t-elle pu financer un tel voyage ?

programme.title: César Wagner
programme.desc: Dans la forêt vosgienne, les autorités retrouvent le corps sans vie d'une journaliste et militante de la cause animale, ainsi que le cadavre d'un lynx.

programme.title: César Wagner
programme.desc: César Wagner enquête sur un meurtre au sein du Théâtre national de Strasbourg, où il retrouve un amour de jeunesse devenue directrice de l'institution.

programme.title: Cassandre
programme.desc: Sur des images de drone, une propriété somptueuse, où l'on découvre dans le jardin un corps sans vie : pas de doute, ce n'est pas une mort naturelle.

programme.title: Cassandre
programme.desc: Un homme est retrouvé inconscient. Il s'agit d'une tentative d'assassinat. Cassandre le place sous protection policière car le tueur pourrait vouloir l'achever.

programme.title: Cassandre
programme.desc: Cassandre enquête sur la mort d'un homme qui venait d'être renvoyé d'une ferme pour avoir utilisé des pesticides. Or l'établissement se revendiquait bio.

programme.desc: Après avoir pris conscience de ce qui lui est arrivé lors de la soirée de la veille, une adolescente se confie au meilleur ami de celui qui a abusé d'elle.

programme.title: Sans filtres
programme.desc: Victime de moqueries et d'humiliations à répétition, une adolescente trouve du soutien auprès de ses amies, découvrant ainsi le pouvoir de la sororité.

programme.title: Saut' la mer
programme.desc: Une adolescente constate le changement de comportement inquiétant de son copain, qui tient des propos misogynes. Elle décide de lui faire entendre raison.

programme.title: Les fils qui nous lient
programme.desc: Camélia et Gabriel sont des amis inséparables. Malheureusement, leur relation est perturbée par la jalousie de leurs partenaires respectifs, Thomas et Kelly.

programme.title: Hors contrôle
programme.desc: Grâce à ses amis, une adolescente réalise que sa relation avec son copain n'est pas saine et que les représentations qu'elle lit sont dommageables.

programme.title: La photo de classe
programme.desc: Au lycée, la photo de classe approche. Cet événement, pourtant anodin, fait resurgir les insécurités de certains élèves concernant leur identité queer.

programme.title: Le Noël de mon meilleur mari
programme.desc: Après avoir planté son futur époux au pied de l'autel, une jeune femme se réfugie chez sa grand-mère pour réfléchir. Elle retrouve un amour de jeunesse.

programme.title: Escales en France
programme.sub-title: Le Jura, entre patrimoine et terroir
programme.desc: Ce magazine va nous faire découvrir les régions françaises en plongeant le téléspectateur au cœur d'une ville, d'un département français, d'une région, et lui fera découvrir son histoire, ses richesses patrimoniales, ses spécialités gastronomiques et ses lieux incontournables… Escales en France va à la rencontre de ces français agriculteurs, marins pêcheurs, artisans, restaurateurs, éleveurs, guides touristiques, tous amoureux fous de leurs régions.

programme.title: Paroles de campagne
programme.desc: Une parole peut convaincre, diviser, inspirer ou choquer, c'est ainsi que chaque semaine Paroles de campagne reprendra les petites phrases et les déclarations marquantes sur l'actualité politique de notre pays.

programme.title: Alors on bouge en région
programme.desc: Des exercices simples et efficaces contre le mal de dos. Cette séance peut être réalisée par tous. Elle permettra de lutter et de prévenir les maux de dos.

programme.title: ICI Matin
programme.desc: De 6h30 à 9h, \" Ici Matin \" est votre premier rendez-vous de la journée avec l'information de proximité. Elle ouvre les matinées 100 % régionales de France 3. Au programme, des journaux d'information en hyper proximité tous les quarts d'heure, des points météo et trafic réguliers, de l'interactivité avec les auditeurs et téléspectateurs, et surtout une grande bouffée de bonne humeur pour démarrer la journée du bon pied !

programme.title: ICI dans votre région
programme.desc: Des magazines ou documentaires proposés par votre antenne régionale.

programme.title: Escales en France

programme.title: Homard et cordon bleu
programme.desc: Sylvain Guillemot se rend chez Jacotte, à Rouziers-de-Touraine. Il cuisine une ballotine de volaille truffée, un risotto à la truffe et une mousseline d'oeufs à la truffe.

programme.title: Homard et cordon bleu
programme.desc: Recette : Filet mignon et boudin noir snacké, tarte croustillante de chou rouge et rillons, touche de miel, gingembre et sarrasin, pickles de radis, purée de patate douce et chou-fleur doré. Cette semaine, notre chef part à la rencontre d'Audrey, cycliste de haut niveau, à Saint-Étienne-du-Gué-de-l'Isle près de Loudéac. Ensemble, ils iront décou...

programme.title: Outremer.l'info
programme.desc: Préparé et proposé par la Rédaction du Pôle Outre-mer Une production France Télévisions Présenté en alternance par Kessi Weishaupt et Laurence Theatin Le journal d'information qui vous emmène au cœur des Outre-mer et de leur actualité.

programme.title: Météo à la carte (la suite)
programme.desc: Une émission réalisée par Captain Productions Une production Enibas Productions, A Prime Group, avec la participation de France Télévisions Rédacteurs en chef : Stéphane Evanno et Laetitia Bouchon Présentée par Marine Vignes et Laurent Romejko En direct Ce nouveau format se veut encore plus interactif. Les téléspectateurs gardent une place importante dans l'émission et sur les réseaux. Les photos et vidéos envoyées vont être davantage mises en valeur.

programme.title: Tandem
programme.desc: Comment Quentin Brunel, étudiant en deuxième année de médecine s'est retrouvé dans un des tiroirs de la morgue de la fac ? Serait-ce un bizutage qui aurait mal tourné ?

programme.title: Tandem
programme.desc: Au cours d'une reconstitution médiévale en costumes, un chevalier s'effondre lors d'un combat à l'épée. Sous le heaume, ce n'est pas un cascadeur, mais la propriétaire du château.

programme.title: Tandem
programme.desc: Patrick Catala, le président de la station SNSM de Port Camargue est retrouvé noyé dans le port. Qui pouvait en vouloir à ce sauveteur passionné ?

programme.title: Stade 2 la quotidienne
programme.desc: Le magazine qui va au-delà du seul résultat sportif : histoires humaines, enjeux sociétaux, innovations, culture sport, inclusion, environnement… Un regard moderne et ouvert sur le sport d'aujourd'hui.

programme.title: Stade 2 Ligue 1
programme.desc: Page quotidienne inédite entièrement dédiée à la Ligue 1 de football, offrant une immersion totale au cœur du championnat de France : dernières actualités, résultats, informations sur les clubs et joueurs du championnat de France de football.

programme.title: Un si grand soleil
programme.desc: Becker reproche à Alix de jouer avec le feu. Au lycée, Pablo s'interroge sur l'attitude étrange d'Alexis.

programme.title: Un si grand soleil
programme.desc: Laurine met sa mère en garde : Guillaume n'est pas celui qu'il prétend être. De son côté, Alain soupçonne un rapprochement entre William et Clémence.

programme.title: Des racines et des ailes
programme.desc: A la découverte des Alpes françaises, du parc régional du Verdon jusqu'au massif des Ecrins, dominé par le sommet emblématique de la Meije à 4000 mètres d'altitude. 1h30 de raquette en hiver est nécessaire pour accéder au village de Dormillouse, au coeur du Parc national des Ecrins. Pas de réseau électrique, pas de route, et pourtant, Claude et Stéphanie ont choisi de s'y installer à l'année.

programme.title: Les héros du patrimoine
programme.desc: En Camargue, la menace n'a plus rien d'abstrait : la montée des eaux, l'érosion, les tempêtes et la salinisation des sols bouleversent déjà le quotidien des habitants.

programme.title: Culture dans votre région
programme.desc: Magazines culturels et spectacles A chaque région son magazine.

programme.title: Wake Up W9
programme.desc: Réveillez-vous de bon pied avec W9 ! Retrouvez une sélection des meilleurs tubes du moment pour un réveil vitaminé...

programme.title: Génération Hit machine
programme.desc: Revivez les moments les plus cultes de l'année 1998 et retrouvez les plus belles prestations de Mylène Farmer. Quels ont été les chanteurs à midinettes de l'époque ? Quelles sont les stars internationales venues chantées sur le plateau ? Toutes les réponses seront commentées par une pléiade d'artistes.

programme.title: Génération Hit machine
programme.desc: Revivez les moments les plus cultes de l'année 1999 et découvrez que cette année fut celle des tubes orientaux. Qui étaient les chanteuses les plus sexy de 1999 ? Quelles stars américaines ont envahi le plateau du Hit ? Toutes les réponses seront commentées par une pléiade d'artistes.

programme.title: Génération Hit machine
programme.desc: Revivez les moments les plus cultes de l'année 1997 (volume 2) et redécouvrez les boys band frenchies venus chanter sur le plateau du Hit. Qui a fait une petite chanson et s'en est allé ? Quelles ont été les meilleures reprises en cette année 1997 ?

programme.title: Fréquenstar
programme.desc: Éric Jean-Jean ouvre les portes de son appartement à un artiste de la scène française pour une heure de télévision rythmée, intime et totalement inédite. Cette saison, Fréquenstar casse les codes de l'interview classique et adopte un nouveau rythme, inspiré des usages des réseaux sociaux.

programme.title: 100% poker
programme.desc: Vous êtes passionné de poker ou simplement attiré par ce jeu de cartes pratiqué dans le monde entier ? Ne ratez pas l'émission référence 100% Poker, animée par Érika Moulet qui, entourée d'experts, décrypte l'actualité de la scène mondiale et distille conseils et anecdotes pour devenir incollable sur le sujet.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: Ve siècle, île de Bretagne. Le royaume de Kaamelott s'organise autour de son souverain, le roi Arthur. Entouré de ses fidèles chevaliers de la Table Ronde, il s'attelle à la mission que les dieux lui ont confiée : rechercher le Saint Graal !

programme.title: Maman, j'ai encore raté l'avion
programme.desc: Un gamin déluré se trompe d'avion, atterrit à New York et mène la vie dure à deux truands benêts qu'il avait déjà matés au cours d'une précédente rencontre.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Séquestré par Hakim, le directeur du NCIS tente de faire passer des informations à ses agents. Il veut protéger sa fille, qui risque d'être assassinée.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Le voisinage d'un lieutenant de la Navy est suspecté de lui avoir donné la mort, tandis que Torres et Palmer passent une soirée mémorable ensemble.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: L'équipe enquête sur l'explosion suspecte qui s'est produite devant la maison d'un officier de la Navy et de son épouse, une star de la téléréalité.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Alors que Gibbs souhaite profiter de ses vacances pour se reposer au calme, il doit attraper un voleur se cachant dans les bois, non loin de sa demeure.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: La découverte d'une cassette vieille de 50 ans prouvant l'innocence d'un Marine condamné à perpétuité pour meurtre pousse le NCIS à rouvrir l'enquête.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Lors d'une visite organisée pour des vétérans, un Caporal chargé d'accompagner l'un d'entre eux est empoisonné.

programme.desc: Le meurtre d'un Marine lié à un gang de motards contraint Torres à replonger dans une ancienne mission d'infiltration. Pour faire avancer l'enquête, il doit révéler à Gibbs un secret qu'il gardait enfoui depuis cette époque.

programme.desc: Un sergent d'artillerie est retrouvé assassiné dans un parc national après une mission au Liberia où il formait des gardes forestiers à lutter contre le braconnage. Gibbs enquête avec May Dawson, la policière montée qui a découvert le corps, tandis que Vance compose avec les pressions de l'ambassadeur du Liberia.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Le NCIS enquête sur le meurtre d'un quartier-maître, retrouvé sur un terrain de golf de Quantico. Pour identifier le suspect, McGee lance des appels sur la radio amateur trouvée chez la victime, tandis que Sloane établit un profil psychologique….

programme.title: Les apprentis aventuriers
programme.desc: La mémoire des candidats peut encore remplir leur bourse de perles. Après l’épreuve, les Roses décident d'appeler leurs proches, une pause émouvante. Laurent prépare ensuite une soirée festive : de quoi retrouver le plaisir d’être ensemble avant la dernière ligne droite.

Julien se précipite à sa recherche et rien ne pourra l'arrêter.
